headline: Rada summoned NBU head Pyshnyi to report on Sense Bank matters on August 20
summary: Ukraine's Verkhovna Rada backed a proposal to summon National Bank of Ukraine head Andriy Pyshnyi to a session on August 20 to report on Sense Bank matters. The motion was put forward by lawmaker Yaroslav Zheleznyak.
why: The National Bank of Ukraine is the country's central bank and banking regulator, so its oversight of troubled lenders affects depositors and investor confidence.
